misprints.note: The genitive ending is printed as 'γος' without the υ.
The print has a double λ.
The genitive ending is printed with an extra σ. This could also be the book's own abbreviation of γαστρός.

uncertain.note: The line is cut off at the right edge of the scan, so the final full stop is not visible. I added it, assuming it is there like at every other entry end. I also split off Brännmärka as its own entry.
The mark after κολποῦν is broken and partly cut at the margin. It looks like a colon, but it could be '.' or '.:'.
Possibly there is a thin space before the parenthesis. I kept it without a space.
